implementation: Phase 1: original self-hosted WebGL2 shader engine; Three.js/R3F + GLB pipeline requires a separately verified dependency-lock migration.
universalRules: Real 3D geometry, not CSS parallax marketed as WebGL.
Meaningful interaction integrated with content, never blocking links or forms.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion, WebGL loss and constrained GPU devices.
No third-party hosted assets, unlicensed logos, or invented customer outcomes.
Each website remains independently navigable and responsive.
Do not merge feature branches to main before passing CI and owner visual review.
